ai_summary: Here's the executive summary:  Brij Rattan Bagri, Promoter & Managing Director of BLB Limited, disclosed the open market purchase of 90,503 equity shares of the company on September 10, 2026, as per SEBI regulations. This transaction increased his total promoter holding from 46.64% to 46.81%, a marginal stake increase of 0.17%. While demonstrating continued promoter confidence, this is a routine regulatory filing with no material impacts on control or discernible red flags.
